definitions.polygon: A closed plane figure formed by three or more straight segments.
definitions.interior angle: An angle inside a polygon between adjacent edges.
definitions.exterior angle: An angle formed by extending a polygon side; one per vertex sums to 360° for a convex polygon.
definitions.parallelogram: A quadrilateral with both pairs of opposite sides parallel.
definitions.rectangle: A parallelogram having four right angles.
definitions.rhombus: A parallelogram with four congruent sides.
definitions.square: A quadrilateral with four right angles and four congruent sides.
definitions.trapezoid: A quadrilateral with at least one pair of parallel sides; definitions may vary by convention.
definitions.kite: A quadrilateral with two pairs of adjacent congruent sides.
definitions.apothem: A perpendicular segment from the center of a regular polygon to one of its sides.
